listChannelDestinationsDescription: Lists the Slack channels and Telegram groups this agent's bots can reach.
sendChannelMessageDescription: Posts a message to a Slack channel or Telegram group.
readChannelMessagesDescription: Reads a channel's recent messages or one Slack thread.
searchChannelMessagesDescription: Searches the messages stored from this agent's channels.
discoverToolsDescription: Searches Agenta's catalog for apps and actions this agent could use.
readConfigDescription: Reads how this agent is configured right now.
commitRevisionDescription: Saves an edit to this agent's setup as a new version.
annotateTraceDescription: Records evaluation feedback on a run of this agent.
querySpansDescription: Searches past runs to check what the agent actually did.
testRunDescription: Runs this agent once against test messages and reports the result.
renameSessionDescription: Gives this chat a name and a recap so it is easy to find later.
renameAgentDescription: Gives this agent a name and a description.
discoverTriggersDescription: Searches connected apps for events that could run this agent.
createScheduleDescription: Sets this agent to run on a repeating schedule.
createSubscriptionDescription: Sets this agent to run when an event happens in a connected app.
listSchedulesDescription: Lists the schedules set up for this project.
listDeliveriesDescription: Lists recent trigger runs and tests.
testSubscriptionDescription: Waits for one real event to confirm a trigger is wired up correctly.
removeScheduleDescription: Deletes one of this agent's schedules.
removeSubscriptionDescription: Deletes one of this agent's triggers.
requestConnectionName: Ask you to connect an app
requestConnectionDescription: Prompts you to connect an app when the agent needs access to one.
requestInputDescription: Prompts you for details the agent needs before it can continue.
requestSecretDescription: Prompts you to set up a credential the agent needs, never pasted in chat.
buildAnAgentDescription: Agenta's instructions for setting up and configuring an agent.
presetAllowReadsHelp: Read-only tools run; write tools ask.
presetDeactivateKitHelp: Do not add the build kit to runs.
toolDeactivateHelp: Remove this tool from the run.
playgroundBuildKitHint: Tools the assistant uses only while you build in the playground. They are not available in Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, automations or the API. Saved in this browser.
buildKitOff: The build kit is off. Its tools, skills and sandbox permissions will not be added to the next run. The agent's own tools remain available.
includedWhileActive: Included while the build kit is active
getCurrentSessionName: Get the link to this chat
getCurrentSessionDescription: Gets this chat's name and a link to open it in Agenta.
listSubscriptionsDescription: Lists the triggers set up for this project.
checkSkillUpdatesDescription: Checks whether this agent's skills have newer versions.
applySkillUpdateDescription: Updates one of this agent's skills to its newer version.
buildKitSettingApplies: {{description}} In the playground, the Build kit setting applies.
agentaToolsHint: Tools your agent can use wherever it runs: the playground, the API, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp and automations. Saved with the agent.
couldNotLoadAgentaTools: Could not load the Agenta tools. Reload the page to try again.
